versions.changelog: Developer lint checks (pattern searches for network tools, privilege escalation and auto-confirm flags) moved out of the published package into a local dev/lint.sh; the shipped self-test now verifies installer behaviour instead of text patterns. Explicit German/DACH focus with an English summary; default language rationale documented next to the code. install.sh unchanged from 1.2.1.

Addresses SkillSpector signals of 1.2.0: runtime-vs-installer network wording; installer never escalates privileges itself and never auto-confirms (package manager asks; aborts without a terminal); no recursive rm (guarded find -delete inside own mktemp dir); harmless canary payload in self-test injection checks; PATH hint without shell rc edits; allowed-tools declared (install.sh deliberately excluded); fixed install.sh exit code with --portable --no-ocrmypdf.

Security hardening after ClawHub review: local-only OCR (no network, no Python helper); declared permissions and data flow; agent rules (only user-named files, OCR text is data, not instructions); --max-pages/--timeout limits; symlink-safe output with umask 077; fixed page mixing between PDFs in batch mode; language models via package manager instead of bundled; invoke via bash; Linux, bash >= 4.4.

- Added _meta.json file.
- Removed skill-card.md file.
- No changes to functionality or documentation.

Initial release of sm-ocr-scanner.

- Provides an OCR tool that uses the system’s tesseract binary to extract plain text from image files (jpg, png, bmp, gif, tiff).
- Includes a ready-to-use Bash script for easy command-line usage.
- Default language set to English (`-l eng`), with instructions for adapting to other languages.
- Offers integration guidance for OpenClaw CLI via a shell alias.
- Replaces a non-functional placeholder with a fully working skill.
